text: Tuma nde heeferve ven huuɓitirnoo on ka dow aynde e ley mayre, senngo fuɗnaange e hiirnaange. Fewndo ontuma, gite ɗen ooñanii kala huunde, si wanaa ndaarugol ayɓe ɓen, ɓerɗe ɗen hewtiri ka lookoƴe, hakkee kulol. Jikkuɗon Alla ontuma, jikke luutondirɗe : tuma goo felliton ballal, tuma goo felliton taƴagol ɗum.
